_comment: The Group Chat Decides Where to Get Brunch — 12,000 messages, one reservation.
The odd one out on purpose: a pure fan-out tree. Every node has exactly one
parent, achieved by giving each branch its own phase, signal and outcome nodes
rather than sharing them. That makes this the only fixture where the per-column
overlap sweep has nothing to do, which is a code path no other fixture covers —
a regression that made the sweep too aggressive would show up here and nowhere
else. Deliberately not a replacement for the shared-middle fixtures; it is the
- the absence of overlap resolution, with placement coming purely from the
- the gap solve on a graph whose tallest node is a leaf rather than a hub;
- four messages of 'it actually happened' against 5,100 of 'the long
silence', so the label drop rule still fires.
Flows are messages and conserve to 12,000 exactly.
Regenerate the derived files with: node tools/generate_golden.mjs
title: The Group Chat Decides Where to Get Brunch
blurb: A pure fan-out tree with no shared middle nodes — the control case where the overlap sweep has nothing to do.
